market_pieman.text: Hot pies! Steak and cider, cheese and onion, mushroom! Built for the drizzle.

then.text: First time today? Have one on the house. Go on, you look peaky.

else.text: You've had your free one. The stall's got bills to pay, my lover.

market_cidershop.text: Cider's been made round here for centuries. Farm workers were once paid partly in cider. Bet that made the afternoons interesting.
Wassailing's in January: you sing to the apple trees, dip toast in cider and hang it in the branches for the robins. Good luck for the harvest.

hall_stallholder.text: Alright my lover! Cider, cheese, pasties and a lot of cheek. What you got for me?
Have a gander at the board. We're not in a hurry. The Nails will wait.
Cheers drive! Tell your friends. Not the ones who owe me money.
